title: Granada Grand Square
author: Andee Graves (Mamas2Hands)
notes: Start: original 'Start square with an adjustable slip knot' and Rnd 1 'ch 4 (counts as center and first dc), (11 dc) in 4th ch from hook' — a centre start equivalent to a ring, recorded as a magic ring (first line added; Round 1 text kept as published). Headings 'Rnd N (RS):' normalised to 'Round N: (RS)'. Stated counts are in square brackets, so the checker can't read them; the DSL was built to match them. Rnd 6 as published repeats its bracket '2 times', which gives only 3 corners/12 shells; the DSL uses 3 repeats to match the stated 16 GrnShl and 4 corners. Standing dc written as dc. Materials, gauge and finishing omitted. Block #21 of the 2024 Moogly CAL, published on the designer's own blog. Stitch graph: round 12 reads badly (cost 137.0); check where its stitches go.
